dog.description_text:
Cody is a sweet, gentle girl who just needs a little time and space to feel comfortable in a new environment. She was understandably unsure during her first couple of days with us, but it has been so rewarding watching her come out of her shell!

Once she feels safe, she’s affectionate, curious, and gets adorably excited to see her people. She’s now comfortable lounging all around the apartment, whether it’s on her bed, the carpet, or wherever she decides is her spot for the day. She is incredibly well house-trained and has settled nicely into our daily routine of walks, meals, treats, and plenty of naps.

Cody is a total sweetie who seems to thrive with a calm, patient home and gets more comfortable and trusting every day.

﻿Cody is approximately 10y 9m 1d old and is fully grown at 45 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
